specs.name: Glossy Jewels
specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite sheet for a friendly royal-castle match-3 game, NOT a screen mockup.
Create exactly 18 isolated icons in a strict uniform 4-column by 5-row grid. Canvas portrait 1024 x 1280. Every grid cell is square, all cells have the same size. Center one icon inside each occupied cell, filling approximately 72% of the cell, with generous completely transparent gutters. Last two cells bottom row remain completely empty. No cell borders, no labels.
Order left to right:
Row 1: red heart; blue water droplet; green leaf; yellow five-point star.
Row 2: purple butterfly; orange gift box with yellow ribbon; blue hexagonal token with yellow plus symbol; cream pointing glove with blue cuff.
Row 3: yellow mallet with purple handle; paint brush with orange handle and multicoloured bristles; blue toy rocket with red fins and yellow band; purple round cartoon bomb with yellow belt and short fuse.
Row 4: rainbow segmented orb with small cream center star; golden hourglass with blue glass and yellow sand; blue heart-shaped locket with gold edge and small gold loop; gold ring with large red gemstone.
Row 5: pale cyan translucent square ice tile with clear empty center, bright frosted rim and two white icy glints; circular royal-blue score medallion with one raised yellow star; EMPTY; EMPTY.
Strong recognisable silhouettes at 32 pixels. Six coloured pieces must each keep their exact colour identity. No faces or eyes. Match all 18 objects to one consistent art style and lighting. No detached sparkles, glows, lettering, numbers, scenery, cast shadows on a surface or contact shadow under icons.
Background MUST be truly transparent RGBA alpha=0 outside the icons and in unused cells; do not draw a checkerboard or a solid background. This is a cutout PNG sprite sheet for compositing onto arbitrary game backgrounds.
Style: Premium playful jewel-like 3D game art. Crisp bevels, chunky faceted forms, vivid ruby red, sapphire blue, emerald green, amethyst purple, sunny gold and orange. Deep saturated shaded edges, controlled bright reflections. Jewel-like translucency and faceted planes on the six pieces. Power-up tools have polished enamel and warm gold trim. Sculptural, compact and luxurious, cheerful rather than photorealistic. Strong silhouette without black outlines. Deliberately different from smooth pillowy clay icons.
